description: Un siècle de gares du réseau ferroviaire français : en service, fermées ou disparues is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Robert Jeansoulin. From the 6442 stations present in the file of “trains operated or not” deposited on data.gouv (Source: several operations were carried out: (1) Data verification: comparison of geographical coordinates and toponyms (where possible) which identified a small percentage of errors, but still a little more than a hundred (concluded on a few lines); (2) confrontation ... Coverage: Robert Jeansoulin. The portal shows the English title as "A century of stations in the French rail network: in service, closed or missing" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Robert Jeansoulin. Its keywords include patrimoine-industriel, territoires-et-transport, patrimoine-departemental, politique-environnementale, transport-public, reseau-ferre. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2022-02-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
